_doc: Promotion-pipeline config (dev → stage → main). DATA file, like polecat-platform's .github/steward/focus.json — editing it is a sanctioned direct commit to main (sessions: pull → edit → push; Manager's Pipeline view: contents-API PUT with sha compare-and-swap). Changes take effect on the next hourly tick of promote-to-stage.yml. Fields: promoteToStage.enabled turns the scheduled dev→stage promotion on/off entirely; paused is a soft hold (schedule keeps ticking, does nothing); everyHours is the cadence; offset anchors which UTC hour the cadence counts from (7Z ≈ 2am Central — overnight, per Kevin); window [start,end) limits promotions to those UTC hours; catchUpHours (default 4) is how long after the firing hour a DELAYED cron tick may still carry the promotion — GitHub routinely runs a scheduled tick 20-30 min late, and a one-hour firing window silently missed the whole nightly sweep on 2026-08-07. Extra ticks inside the catch-up window exit quietly once stage already contains dev. Manual dispatches of promote-to-stage.yml ignore the schedule. stage→prod promotion is promote-to-prod.yml, dispatch-only, and refuses while the latest stage promotion run is red unless requireGreenStageForProd is false or the dispatch passes force.

gates.devGate: tools/validate.mjs + tools/changelog-check.js + tools/dev-smoke.mjs (ci.yml on PRs into dev and pushes to dev)
gates.stageSuite: the FULL tests/run.js suite on the stage tree, then dev-smoke against the STAGED /stage/ form (promote-to-stage.yml)
